features.note: Thick, dark, arched brows with an angled peak, consistent with the references.
Light grey almond eyes. They read slightly smaller and more hooded than the wide, bright silver-grey eyes in the references.
Long, straight, fairly narrow nose, broadly consistent.
Full lips with a defined cupid's bow, similar shape and tone.
The face reads longer and more angular, with a heavier jaw and a more mature look. It lacks the softer oval, high cheekbones and tapered chin of the references.
Black curly hair ends just below the shoulders. The reference hair falls well past the shoulders, to mid-torso.
The bust is full, but the hips and thighs look noticeably narrower and slimmer than the wide-hipped, full-thighed hourglass in the reference full-body panels.

summary: The candidate looks like a similar woman with matching brows, eyes and coloring, but her longer, more angular face, shorter hair and slimmer hips mean she would not be recognized as Priya Mehta without hesitation, although the frame itself is clean for animation.
